name: llm-to-jev
title: Replacing an LLM Classifier with Jev
description: Evaluate moving an LLM-based classifier to Jev, which answers with calibrated probabilities instead of text, and carry the move out. Compares Jev with the LLM on past records, has a person annotate a blind sample of disagreements and random records in about an hour, uses the annotations to add rules and choose per-label thresholds, and exports a configuration to run Jev in production, with optional checks for drift.
author: Explosion

name: llm-classifier-eval
title: Evaluating an LLM Classifier
description: Measure a classifier that's built on an LLM prompt against people, without changing it. A stratified random sample of its real decisions is labelled blind after a short pilot, disagreements are settled with both answers in view, and the result is accuracy and per-label precision, recall and true rates across all of its traffic, with confidence intervals, plus a gold set to re-score every prompt change against.
author: Explosion

name: helpdesk-routing
title: Helpdesk Routing with Jev
description: Find out whether Jev is good enough to route IT support tickets to the right technician by problem area. Settles the label scheme in a pilot with a Gemini second opinion, builds a human-labelled evaluation set with an agreement check and a blind slip check, scores Jev against a bar agreed in advance, and sets up daily routing with a monthly problem-area report.
author: Explosion

name: support-insights
title: Support Ticket Insights
description: Extract products, features, error codes, versions and integrations from customer support tickets and route each ticket to the right queue. An LLM drafts the entity annotations, people curate them, a pretrained pipeline suggests the generic entity types, and the passes are adjudicated into a gold set that trains a custom spaCy NER pipeline and a separate routing classifier.
author: Explosion

name: github-docs-issues
title: GitHub Docs Issue Classifier
description: Train a binary text classifier that predicts whether a GitHub issue is about documentation. Annotate a single label with accept or reject on the included GitHub issues or your own, then train a spaCy pipeline on the answers.
author: Explosion

name: food-ingredients-ner
title: Food Ingredient Extraction
description: Train a named entity recognizer that finds food ingredients in cooking comments from Reddit or your own texts. Highlight ingredients with match patterns as suggestions, train a quick first model on CPU and a more accurate transformer-based pipeline on GPU, and optionally correct the first model's suggestions in a second round and check the annotations in a dashboard.
author: Explosion
